method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Asian Stocks Slip as AI Rally Stalls, Oil Steadies: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Captures the dominant cross‑regional equity narrative: AI leadership momentum pausing and its negative transmission to Asian markets. High relevance because it signals a broad rotation/weakening in risk appetite tied to tech/AI names.

Equities.title: S&P 500: Tech wobble but breadth improves – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank analysts describe a mixed backdrop for US equities, with the S&P 500 rebounding on broad participation even as chipmakers lag after Broadcom’s disappointing AI guidance.
Equities.reason: Nuanced, market‑internals piece: improved breadth is a constructive counter‑signal to the tech wobble. Treated as a lower‑relevance counterpoint to the broader AI/tech selloff theme.

Equities.title: Broadcom revenue miss hits semiconductor stocks as Dow rallies to new highs
Equities.reason: Earnings/guidance shock from a major AI/chip supplier is a primary catalyst for the market rotation out of semiconductors and into defensives/mega‑caps — a high‑impact, market‑wide risk signal.

Equities.title: Broadcom's sell-off just entered mega-cap history
Equities.reason: Reinforces the Broadcom‑led theme: a large cap guidance miss creating outsized market moves and prompting sector rotation; included as corroborating evidence with moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Stocks drop as AI rally pauses, US-Iran peace talks stall
Equities.reason: Combines AI‑led equity weakness with geopolitical friction — both important macro drivers of risk sentiment and market breadth. Treated as a broadly relevant market narrative.

Equities.title: Cracks Emerge in Kospi’s 105% Rally as Breadth Concerns Mount
Equities.reason: Regional example of AI/chip concentration risks and breadth deterioration — supports the broader theme of narrow leadership and rising market fragility.

Equities.title: S&P Dow Jones Keeps MegaCap IPO Rules As Is After Consultation
Equities.reason: Market‑structure decision limits early index inclusion for mega IPOs (SpaceX/others), dampening a potential source of near‑term passive inflows into mega‑caps — modestly negative for immediate liquidity dynamics.

Equities.title: Stock Market Today: Stock Futures Dip as Investors Await Jobs Report
Equities.reason: Macro calendar risk: positioning cautious ahead of US jobs data, a classic near‑term driver of equity volatility and risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Tracking website, food watch: South Korea is obsessing over Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's visit
Equities.summary: South Korean investors are eagerly tracking Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's every move as they wait to see what the AI megacap company will do next.
Equities.reason: Illustrates continued market focus on AI megacaps as leadership theme. Treated as a supporting, modestly positive signal for AI‑led risk appetite despite short‑term wobble.

Rates.title: India's cenbank cuts growth outlook, raises inflation forecast as it keeps rates steady at 5.25%
Rates.summary: RBI raised its inflation projection for the year ending March 2027 by 50 basis points to 5.1%, while cutting growth forecast to 6.6% for the year, from 6.9%.
Rates.reason: RBI kept policy unchanged but materially raised its inflation projection — implies higher-for-longer bias for Indian yields and upward pressure on rates; high relevance for local bond market and EM rates sentiment.

Rates.title: India scraps tax on overseas bond investors in bid to attract foreign capital and shore up the rupee
Rates.summary: India has announced several measures to boost capital inflows, including the scrapping of capital gains tax for foreign investors in government bonds.
Rates.reason: Removal of taxes for overseas bond investors should boost foreign demand for Indian government bonds, supporting bond prices (yields lower) — a direct policy to attract inflows with material impact on rates.

Rates.title: Danantara Plans New Low-Yield Bond as Investors Shun Indonesia
Rates.reason: Issuer signalling weak demand in Indonesia's bond market points to risk-off pressure and potential upward pressure on Indonesian yields; relevant for EM sovereign rates and supply/demand dynamics.

Rates.title: Purbaya Slams ‘Sell Indonesia’ Narrative, Points to Bond Inflows
Rates.reason: Government official pushing back on 'sell' narrative and citing bond inflows is a counter-signal that could temper sovereign spread widening; lower relevance as it's a rhetorical/flow reassurance rather than hard data.

Rates.title: Top Chinese Insurers Start Buying Dim Sum Notes Via Bond Connect
Rates.reason: Domestic institutional demand for offshore RMB notes via Bond Connect implies increased flows into Chinese debt markets, supportive for bond prices (yields lower) and relevant for China rates and CNH/RMB funding.

Rates.title: China Allows Some Banks to Offer Higher Rates on Dollar Deposits
Rates.reason: Permitting higher USD deposit rates raises dollar funding costs in China and signals competition for USD liquidity; modest upward pressure on USD funding rates and a small negative for bond markets via funding-channel impact.

Rates.title: Nonfarm Payrolls set to show stable labor market in May as markets digest Fed hawkish shift
Rates.summary: The United States (US) Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will release the Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for May on Friday at 12:30 GMT.
Rates.reason: Stable/firm US payrolls against a backdrop of a hawkish Fed shift raises the odds of higher-for-longer US policy, putting upward pressure on Treasury yields — high relevance for global rates pricing.

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (April-June 2026) (Schedule Updates)
Rates.reason: BOJ outright purchase schedule updates indicate central bank support for JGB demand; this is directly supportive of Japanese bond prices (yields lower) and relevant to global carry/flow dynamics into JGBs.

Rates.title: Financial stability vulnerabilities remain elevated as geoeconomic shock unfolds
Rates.reason: ECB warning that financial stability vulnerabilities remain elevated can raise risk premia and influence ECB policy prudence — net negative for sovereign spreads and bond markets given higher uncertainty.

FX.reason: DXY softening ahead of NFP signals broad USD weakness — high relevance for FX flows and cross-rate moves.

FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is navigating rough waters, in the stark divergence between persistent domestic inflation and slowing economic growth.
FX.reason: AUD weakness narrative versus USD driven by growth/inflation divergence — FX-native and medium relevance for AUD/USD positioning.

FX.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Holds gains above 0.5850, but stays constrained under 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair trades with mild gains around 0.5865 during the early European session on Friday, bolstered by hawkish signals from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ). All eyes will be on the US Nonfarm Payrolls data for May, which is due later on Friday.
FX.reason: NZD/USD supported by hawkish RBNZ signals — relevant for antipodean USD crosses and short-term FX flows ahead of NFP.

FX.reason: SNB resistance and CHF losing safe-haven appeal is a modest risk-on signal in FX; low-to-moderate relevance for cross- and policy-watchers.

Commodities.reason: Stalled US‑Iran ceasefire talks plus rate‑hike fears driving gold selling and volatility. This is a higher-relevance macro driver for precious metals (geopolitics + rates) — material near-term negative pressure.
